table_description: Dimension table for individual web pages within a website. SCD Type 2. Referenced by WEB_SALES.WS_WEB_PAGE_SK and WEB_RETURNS.WR_WEB_PAGE_SK. Describes page characteristics like type, content richness, and link count — useful for analyzing which page types drive conversions.
use_cases: Web page conversion and revenue analysis
Page type sales performance (product pages vs landing pages)
Auto-generated vs manually created page performance
data_quality_notes: SCD Type 2 — WP_REC_END_DATE IS NULL for current pages.
WP_AUTOGEN_FLAG: 'Y' if the page was auto-generated, 'N' if manually created.
WP_CHAR_COUNT is the character count of the page content.
WP_LINK_COUNT, WP_IMAGE_COUNT, WP_MAX_AD_COUNT describe page content structure.

table_columns.name: WP_WEB_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by WEB_SALES.WS_WEB_PAGE_SK.

table_columns.name: WP_REC_END_DATE
table_columns.description: SCD end date. NULL = currently active.

table_columns.name: WP_CREATION_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. When the page was created.

table_columns.name: WP_ACCESS_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Last access date.

table_columns.name: WP_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: FK to CUSTOMER. Customer associated with this page (e.g. personalized page).

table_columns.name: WP_LINK_COUNT
table_columns.description: Number of outbound links on the page.

table_columns.name: WP_IMAGE_COUNT
table_columns.description: Number of images on the page.

table_columns.name: WP_MAX_AD_COUNT
table_columns.description: Maximum number of ads displayed on the page.
